_comment: P25 Commit 7 runtime A/B — ReoptimizationPeriod sweep. Goal: measure how the reoptimization period (and the compare-and-keep it triggers every period-th interval) affects average SP and per-activation scheduler runtime, against BF (brute-force ceiling). Schedulers: BF, INCR_Reopt_1, INCR_Reopt_5, INCR_Reopt_10, INCR_Reopt_30, INCR_Reopt_60. The INCR_Reopt_X arms are plain INCR with GlobalVariables::ReoptimizationPeriod overridden to X at binary startup (RunOrchestrator.cpp parses the suffix from the mode string); the orchestrator dispatches them identically to INCR. X is the reopt period: X=1 reopts every interval (max reopt), larger X = more incremental. P2.4 renamed the family from the retired INCR_P<n> form (the P<n> knob ran the wrong way for a reader -- P1 read as incremental but was the max-reopt arm); a stale INCR_P<n> config now fails loudly. INCR_Reopt_5 is a NEW arm (the existing family was {1,10,30,60}). P1.4 history: this config previously also carried INCR_P<n>_ADOPTED twins that set ReoptStartFromAdoptedTL=true (reopt descent seeds from the carried adopted TL, ReconstructTimeLimitVecFromResOpt, instead of the Gaussian-mean TL, InitializeTimeLimitsFromETConfig). P1.4 made that adopted-TL seed the PERMANENT, UNCONDITIONAL reopt policy (the seed must be the optimizer's own prior result, not a YAML value) and REMOVED the flag + the _ADOPTED arms; a stale _ADOPTED arm now fails loudly (hard error in MaybeOverrideReoptPeriod) rather than silently dispatching to an empty result. INCR_Reopt_1 = reopt every interval, compare-and-keep against the running incumbent (the always-reopt-with-memory upper bound). Reopt_5/10/30/60 show priority drift vs. reopt frequency. P2.5 removed the INCR_SCRATCH amnesiac control (it weakly dominated under INCR_Reopt_1 and muddied the baseline table); a stale INCR_SCRATCH config now fails loudly (dispatch falls through to the RM baseline). The period-0 'off' baseline is NOT included — Commit 6 made ReoptimizationPeriod positive-only (min 1). Use: MODE=prod CONFIG_JSON=simulation_experiments/configs/p25_period_ab_config.json ./scripts/run_end_to_end.sh. Note: the release binary must be rebuilt after Commit 6 (the dispatcher Optimize_w_TL_ScratchOrIncre must be linked in, else ReoptimizationPeriod is dead config).
_comment_on_naming: All keys use full descriptive names, mirroring experiment_config.json. Times are in seconds unless noted.

test_mode._comment: Fast smoke: 1 taskset, 70s, N=6 only, all six arms (5 plain INCR_Reopt_X + BF). Validates that INCR_Reopt_X modes run end-to-end and produce interval_sp_metrics + scheduler_execution_time before launching the full A/B.

prod_mode._comment: Full A/B: 5 random tasksets per task count, N={4,6,8}, 300s @ interval 10s (~30 scheduling triggers per run). base_random_seed=1000 so tasksets are deterministic and comparable across arms. 6 arms (5 plain INCR_Reopt_X + BF); parallel_worker_processes=4 queues them across 4 workers within a taskset (arms are independent).

plotting._comment: Publication-quality figure styling parameters (same defaults as experiment_config.json).

analysis._comment: Parameters controlling metric computation and data filtering (same defaults as experiment_config.json). enable_resume_from_existing_results=true so a partial A/B run can be resumed by re-invoking the same command.
